messages.subject: Interleaved histogram and bar labels
parts:
Dear all,

I have a dataset with two categorical variables, EOU and Task:

1) EOU can be either "very difficult", "difficult", "not easy", "average", "not difficult", "easy", or "very easy".
2) Task can be either "T1", "T2", "T3"

By using the following command:

ggplot(data=eoulong, aes(x=EOU, fill=Task)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.3, position="dodge") + xlim("very difficult", "difficult", "not easy", "average", "not difficult", "easy", "very easy") + xlab("") + ylab("Frequency")

I can actually plot an interleaved histogram. Furthermore, if I try to add:

 + stat_bin(geom="text", aes(label=..count..), position="dodge")

all frequencies are shown in the middle of the bin, and not right over the corresponding bar:

How can I fix this issue and display the text correctly?

Thanks in advance!

Pierpaolo.
